body:
So basicly, There is something that has been scaring me everyday. About 4 weeks ago, I took '7' 25mg Diphenhydramine and I have had the weirdest reaction to it ever. I feel brain dead, like I am dreaming while awake. My memory is terrible, I am terribly depressed and the entire feeling of being disconnected haunts me everyday. Is this Temporary? I need to know. It is not cool guys. Reading is very difficult, visualizing things in my head is also really difficult.
I have taken around 6 tablets before and felt fine. How come I am going crazy now?!?
One thing to know- I did about 200mg of DXM 4 days previously. Could this of done anything?
